grammar: Same as Hubble: one fluid, many sectors. Quiet/storm, slow/fast, ocean/air are interfaces, not extra laws.

predictions.name: usgs_comcat_gr_b_value
predictions.kill_if: USGS ComCat / ISC-GEM named global MLE b-value outside 0.90–1.10
predictions.what_it_is: Global magnitude-frequency slope b = φ − 1/φ = 1. Same acoustic counting as a Poisson process in the crustal fluid.
predictions.what_it_is_not: A date or place for the next M≥7 earthquake.

predictions.name: slow_fast_rupture_one_valve
predictions.sota_label: two unrelated constitutive laws (SSE vs EQ)
predictions.kill_if: community consensus that slow slip and fast earthquakes require two constitutive laws with no viscosity / rate-state continuum
predictions.future_survey: slow-slip moment-duration scaling literature (SSE vs EQ)
predictions.what_it_is: POOF = fast rupture (orifice open). SUCTION = slow slip (re-compaction). Same T3 valve, different viscosity. C10 at crustal scale.
predictions.what_it_is_not: A forecast of a specific slow-slip episode.

predictions.name: volcanology_gvp_residual_hold
predictions.future_survey: Smithsonian GVP + USGS volcano monitoring feeds
predictions.what_it_is: Eruption catalogs stay on the seed residual. VEI is a POOF-orifice class.
predictions.what_it_is_not: The date of the next VEI≥4 eruption.

predictions.name: swpc_kp_dst_classifier_hold
predictions.kill_if: space_weather or geomagnetism classifier panel exceeds 0.5% / 99.5% accuracy on SWPC refresh
predictions.what_it_is: Quiet vs storm are two sectors of the same solar-terrestrial valve (PRED-007 already locked ionospheric β).
predictions.what_it_is_not: A flare time-of-arrival for a named AR.

predictions.name: ndbc_fluid_tanks_residual_hold
predictions.kill_if: Between_Scale_Interconnects fluid_tanks_* channels exceed 0.5% on NDBC refresh
predictions.what_it_is: Same buoy pressure/SST/wind on Fluid, Ocean, Air folds. ENSO is κ not a new oscillator.
predictions.what_it_is_not: Next week's local forecast or the next El Niño onset date.

predictions.name: seismic_acoustic_prem_hold
predictions.kill_if: lithosphere vp/vs median channel exceeds 0.5% (deep PREM stays structural)
predictions.what_it_is: Mafic/lid Poisson ν=D_atomic/25. Deep phase changes are other interfaces.
predictions.what_it_is_not: A new radial Earth model replacing PREM.

predictions.name: solar_quiet_storm_two_sectors
predictions.sota_label: one solar-activity number for the whole cycle
predictions.kill_if: quiet-time and storm-time SWPC classes collapse to one residual sector on refresh
predictions.future_survey: NOAA SWPC F10.7 + Kp class products; solar cycle 26 onset (2030s)
predictions.what_it_is: Same grammar as Hubble: quiet and storm are different bubble-density sectors of one solar valve. Cycle 25 SSN is not relocked after the peak.

predictions.name: climate_station_and_marine_hold
predictions.kill_if: climate_observed or NDBC fluid-tank channels exceed 0.5%
predictions.future_survey: NOAA NCEI + NDBC continuous (pairs with PRED-054)
predictions.what_it_is: Weather/climate as Meteorology+Ocean+Fluid tanks, already green.
predictions.what_it_is_not: S2S ensemble beating ECMWF at week 3–4.

predictions.name: dated_fluid_pressure_forecasts
predictions.sota_label: no dated FSOT spatial-class forecast layer
predictions.kill_if: issued forecast JSON rewritten after valid_from, or scoring abandoned
predictions.future_survey: USGS FDSN + NOAA SWPC + NDBC after each valid_to
predictions.what_it_is: Live pressure cells → location + calendar window. Score hit/miss. Iron the valve.
predictions.what_it_is_not: A clock-time for a single hypocenter, or a USGS/NWS watch replacement.

predictions.name: noaa_coastal_tides_residual_hold
predictions.what_it_is: Station residual hold. Dated surge windows use POOF metres under PRED-064.
predictions.what_it_is_not: A beat of NOAA harmonic tables at every minute.

predictions.name: exoplanet_architecture_class_hold
predictions.kill_if: Exoplanet_System_Architecture pooled median exceeds 0.5% on NASA archive refresh
predictions.what_it_is: Radius–period–insolation as one D=21 fold. Not one ε per planet.
predictions.what_it_is_not: The discovery date of the next transiting Earth analog.

predictions.name: gwtc_chirp_mass_class_hold
predictions.kill_if: compact_object_binary_events chirp-mass class exceeds 0.5% on GWTC refresh
predictions.future_survey: GWOSC / GWTC O4 remainder and O5
predictions.what_it_is_not: The GPS time of the next compact-binary merger.

predictions.name: gbif_occurrence_class_hold
predictions.what_it_is_not: The date a named species arrives in a new county.

predictions.name: epidemiology_class_hold
predictions.kill_if: epidemiology_panel_benchmark exceeds 0.5% on World Bank / WHO refresh
predictions.future_survey: World Bank / WHO named health-indicator refreshes
predictions.what_it_is: Class counts on the same valve as GR b-value (24 rec / 0.015%).
predictions.what_it_is_not: The start date of the next named outbreak in a named city.

predictions.name: hydrology_flood_quiet_two_sectors
predictions.sota_label: one catchment-specific flood law per gage
predictions.kill_if: high-flow and quiet NWIS classes collapse to one residual sector, or issued hydro windows never scored
predictions.future_survey: USGS NWIS IV/DV after each hydrology window
predictions.what_it_is: High-flow vs quiet = two sectors of one valve (load bar = 1+POOF). Dated 7-day gage windows.
predictions.what_it_is_not: Street-level inundation maps. A 0.5% central on one gage's next-hour stage.

predictions.name: grace_greenland_mass_delta_hold
predictions.kill_if: grace_cryosphere |delta| scalar median exceeds 0.5% on GravIS refresh
predictions.future_survey: GFZ GravIS Greenland mass time series
predictions.what_it_is: Month-to-month |delta| APPLY residual (live 0.023%). Decline classifier is separate.
predictions.what_it_is_not: The calendar day the next ice shelf calves.

predictions.name: agriculture_season_class_hold
predictions.kill_if: agriculture_agroecology_gap_fill pooled median exceeds 0.5% on GBIF / World Bank refresh
predictions.future_survey: GBIF crop-proxy + World Bank agriculture indicator refreshes
predictions.what_it_is: Season-class residual (276 rec / 0.018%). Same viscosity as ecology and hydrology.
predictions.what_it_is_not: County bushels next Tuesday. A USDA yield-number pick after harvest.

predictions.name: gaia_parallax_class_hold
predictions.sota_label: one free epsilon per Gaia source
predictions.kill_if: Gaia astrometry / CAT-GAIA-DR3 pooled median exceeds 0.5% on DR4 / DR3 reprocess
predictions.future_survey: Gaia DR4 / DR3 reprocess public samples
predictions.what_it_is_not: A new H0 from one star.

predictions.name: paleoclimate_class_hold
predictions.kill_if: paleoclimate_panel pooled median exceeds 0.5% on ice-core / paleo class refresh
predictions.what_it_is: Millennial climate class (20 rec / 0.006%; extension 40 / 0.015%). Distinct from PRED-054 NCEI.
